rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN CTA / Renal Artery Stenosis
rules.source_quote: In a patient with hypertension AND prior abnormal or inconclusive ultrasound with any ONE of the following (1,2): ● Onset of hypertension prior to the age of 30 without a family history of hypertension and when there is suspicion of fibromuscular dysplasia or a vasculitis ● Failure to obtain adequate blood pressure control on 3 antihypertensive medications, including one diuretic

criteria.description: Documented hypertension with prior abnormal or inconclusive renal artery duplex ultrasound
Early onset (<30 yr) without family history OR resistant hypertension on 3 medications including diuretic
Onset of hypertension prior to age 30 without family history
Refractory hypertension failing 3 concurrent antihypertensive drugs including a diuretic

required_documentation: Renal duplex ultrasound report demonstrating abnormal or inconclusive velocity measurements
Medication administration record detailing 3 concurrent antihypertensive agents with diuretic
rules.review_notes: Secondary renovascular hypertension indication requiring prior ultrasound failure.

rules.source_quote: Initial evaluation of inconclusive vascular findings on prior imaging of the abdomen

criteria.description: Inconclusive or equivocal vascular finding on prior abdominal ultrasound or CT

required_documentation: Prior abdominal imaging report citing indeterminate vascular abnormality requiring definitive angiography
rules.review_notes: Diagnostic clarification pathway for indeterminate vascular findings.
